食べる [たべる] (common)

Writings: 食べる・喰べる
Readings: たべる
Furigana: 食[た]べる

Ichidan verb; transitive verb

  1. to eat
  2. to live on (e.g. a salary); to live off; to subsist on

Synonyms:
  食う  [くう]
     to eat
  有る  [ある]
     to be

Examples:

  1. いつから日本人は精白米を食べるようになったのですか？
     When did the Japanese start eating polished rice?
